SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: A report says OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, letting eligible businesses claim a profile, manage their information and see how people engage with them.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind opened Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, describing it as its strongest model for long-horizon tasks, with extended verification loops across coding, cybersecurity and science.

SIGNALS.name: Demis Hassabis
SIGNALS.summary: Demis Hassabis says Gemini 4 Carbon is rolling out today, and shows it reverse engineering his original Theme Park game binaries and porting the game to the web in one shot.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon is now available, positioned for the hardest problems, while Gemini 4 Argon remains the choice for complex tasks.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 is available on all paid plans, the Claude Platform and major clouds, priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output, down from $10 and $50.

SIGNALS.name: Claude
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical work, with improvements in coding, reasoning and vision.

SIGNALS.name: agim
SIGNALS.summary: Unconfirmed: a report said OpenAI's 6.2 Sol and Astra models might launch Friday. That passed without a launch, though Sol appeared on a Google Cloud quotas page and two hidden OpenAI models showed up in Devin.

SIGNALS.name: Aravind Srinivas
SIGNALS.summary: Perplexity's CEO argues agents will increasingly be used by other agents, with git as a shared record, so that version-controlled traces make a measurable recursive improvement loop possible.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, an updated video generation model from DeepMind with better consistency, more creative control, and 30% lower cost.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a model for security research. It says the model powered its Linux kernel research and is being used by teams at Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks and Cisco.

SIGNALS.name: Perplexity
SIGNALS.summary: Perplexity introduced Teammates, agents that take on ongoing jobs using Computer tasks, skills, memory and tools, and can message coworkers in Slack. Available to Max subscribers on the web.
